identificationModule.officialTitle: A Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Anti-CEA CAR-T Cells in the Treatment of Postoperative Minimal Residual Lesions in Colorectal Cancer Patients With Liver Metastases

primaryOutcomes.measure: Security (Incidence and severity of adverse events)
primaryOutcomes.description: To evaluate the possible reatment related adverse events(TEAEs) occurred within the first 28 days after anti-CEA CAR-T infusion, including replicative lentiviruses(RCL), anti-drug antibody(ADA), and the incidence and severity of symptoms such as cytokine release syndrome(CRS) and CAR-T related encephalopathy syndrome(CRES).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Observation 28 days after CAR-T cells infusion

primaryOutcomes.description: Recurrence by ctDNA MRD detection or imaging diagnosis
2-year recurrence-free survival rate based on imageological examination.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The peak concentration of anti-CEA CAR-T cells amplified in the peripheral blood (Cmax, detected by flow cytometry and qPCR).
The exposed quantity of anti-CEA CAR-T cells amplified in the peripheral blood(aera under the curve, AUC, detected by flow cytometry and qPCR).
